design.seeding: path_seed = SeedSequence([seed, event_index, replicate]); episode SeedSequence(path_seed).spawn(14): children 0-11 = ['selection', 'market', 'spread', 'bridge', 'settlement', 'jump', 'flow_sign', 'background', 'l_aux', 'u_m', 'u_l', 'snipe'] (Tier 1), 12 = jump_thinning, 13 = jump_superposition

hjb.quote_extractor: Original monte_carlo._batch_optimal_quotes; neighboring q clipped exactly as in reproduction
hjb.fractional_inventory: Linear value interpolation; same contracts as original; no inventory rescaling

information_revealed.estimator: matching.rb_uncertainty at s = 1 on matching.sample_draws with TemplateDesign(jump_rate_scale = dose); p0 = 0.5
information_revealed.class_aggregate: equal-weight mean over R* templates; SE = sqrt(sum SE_t^2)/K
information_revealed.jump_share: (I_d - I_0x) / I_d within the dose family
